name: QualysContainerScan
description: Scan Docker container images for vulnerabilities using Qualys QScanner CLI
author: Andrew Nelson (anelson@qualys.com)

inputs.name: qualysConnection
inputs.label: Qualys Service Connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the Qualys API service connection

inputs.name: imageId
inputs.label: Image ID or Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Docker image ID (SHA256) or fully qualified image name (e.g., myregistry/myimage:tag)

inputs.name: storageDriver
inputs.label: Storage Driver
inputs.helpMarkDown: Use local container runtime storage for faster scanning

inputs.name: platform
inputs.label: Platform
inputs.helpMarkDown: Platform for multi-arch images (e.g., linux/amd64, linux/arm64)

inputs.name: usePolicyEvaluation
inputs.label: Use Qualys Policy Evaluation
inputs.helpMarkDown: Use centralized Qualys policy for pass/fail determination. Requires policy configuration in Qualys. If disabled, local thresholds are used.

inputs.name: policyTags
inputs.label: Policy Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated policy tags to evaluate (e.g., production,ci-cd)

inputs.name: maxCritical
inputs.label: Max Critical Vulnerabilities
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum allowed critical vulnerabilities before failing. Set to -1 for unlimited.

inputs.name: maxHigh
inputs.label: Max High Vulnerabilities
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum allowed high severity vulnerabilities before failing. Set to -1 for unlimited.

inputs.name: maxMedium
inputs.label: Max Medium Vulnerabilities
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum allowed medium severity vulnerabilities before failing. Set to -1 for unlimited.

inputs.name: maxLow
inputs.label: Max Low Vulnerabilities
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum allowed low severity vulnerabilities before failing. Set to -1 for unlimited.

inputs.name: scanSecrets
inputs.label: Scan for Secrets
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enable secrets detection to find exposed credentials, API keys, and tokens

inputs.name: continueOnError
inputs.label: Continue on Error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Continue pipeline even if scan fails thresholds or encounters errors

inputs.name: publishResults
inputs.label: Publish SARIF Results
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish SARIF results to Azure DevOps for code scanning alerts

inputs.name: createWorkItems
inputs.label: Create Work Items
inputs.helpMarkDown: Create Azure DevOps Bug work items for discovered vulnerabilities. Requires 'Allow scripts to access OAuth token' enabled in pipeline settings.

inputs.name: workItemSeverities
inputs.label: Minimum Severity
inputs.helpMarkDown: Create work items for vulnerabilities at or above this severity level

inputs.name: workItemAreaPath
inputs.label: Area Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Area path for created work items. Defaults to project root if not specified.

outputVariables.name: policyResult
outputVariables.description: Policy evaluation result (ALLOW, DENY, AUDIT, NONE)

outputVariables.name: reportPath
outputVariables.description: Path to the SARIF report file
